page.overview:
Who is Cervantis?

is a character appearing in . He is the former president of Exceed, Gibeon's estranged son-in-law, and Amethio's father.

It is also implied loves his late wife Maria deeply, still wearing his ring even years after he was widowed.

As implied by Gibeon, was formerly a member of the Explorers when he was inducted as a young man, before he quit due to ideological differences and became the president of Exceed. This decision had led to him being exiled by his own father-in-law, who was furious by his deviation. However, his boss is still Gibeon, who monitors his every decision for the company.

When Professor Friede, who is a former employee of Exceed, tried to gain information from Crave about the rumored Eternal Grace related to Terapagos, said he could not provide any concrete answers due to pressure from higher-ups. However, he still gave Friede the latter's staff ID for Friede to access certain areas of the company.
